name: seo-butler
description: An expert SEO & GEO agency for developers, inside Claude Code. Reads your actual project, detects the stack, and does the technical SEO work an agency would — sitemap, robots.txt, titles and meta, canonicals, Open Graph, JSON-LD, alt text, Core Web Vitals — always behind a plan you approve, with a git-aware backup and rollback. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is first-class: getting you crawled and cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and AI Overviews, not just ranked by Google. Four commands forming a loop: /seo audits, plans and applies; /seo-live proves it actually shipped by checking the deployed site's raw response; /seo-watch is a read-only weekly watchdog that diffs live reality against a stored baseline and reports regressions; /seo-report reads Search Console a month later, compares it against the snapshot from when the work landed, and turns the difference into the next prioritized plan — correlating movements with its own changelog without ever claiming causation. Ships deterministic validators, so the score is computed rather than estimated and two runs on an unchanged site agree — and it measures performance with a real Chrome DevTools trace instead of guessing it from the code, so Core Web Vitals findings come with observed numbers and named causes.
